description: This file defines the class CloudStoreImplementation, which implements the interfaces IStore2 and IConfiguration for a cloud storage component within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for configuration, registration, value management, and namespace operations, along with private member variables.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements cloud storage and configuration interfaces for the plugin, managing registration, value setting/getting, and namespace deletion.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the cloud store with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback with the account store.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback from the account store.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair within a specified scope and namespace.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key within a scope and namespace.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key within a scope and namespace.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace within a scope.
